hero.title: <PLACEHOLDER PODCAST NAME>
hero.body: Lulu and Meiling are both Asian American small business builders. Together, they want to share behind-the-scenes stories of other Asian Americans building something they're proud of — a local coffee shop, a restaurant passed down from their parents, a tech product, a community — and beyond.

bands.title: Why do they build?
bands.body: Giving up the comfort and stability of a 9-5, paychecks, health insurance, a prestigious job title. In exchange for working 24/7, doing anything and everything, and unsolicited comments from family and friends. Listen to stories of builders.

bands.title: Join the conversation. Ask anything.
bands.body: A new episode is released every Tuesday. Join the live discussion, bring your questions. Meet other builders, and talk about the not-so-pretty things no one talks about.

people.name: Lulu
people.bio: Founder, ex Reddit, Square. Building Bagel², software for small businesses.

people.name: Meiling
people.bio: Meiling and her husband founded Catfight Coffee, an artisan coffee brand that blends punk rock, Halloween and vintage style. You can find them online, at the store in Boonton, NJ, and at pop-up events across the US.

bands.title: Want to hear someone's story?
bands.body: Invite them to the conversation. No win is too small and no story is too messy. We want to hear it all. If that's you or someone you know, tell us.
